mil6.1.3:1.2: Gihino vā 'haṃ bhikkhave pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi, gihī vā bhikkhave pabbajito vā sammā paṭipanno sammāpaṭipattādhikaraṇaṃ ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan-ti.
mil6.1.3:1.3: Yadi bhante Nāgasena gihī odātavasano kāmabhogī puttadārasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasanto Kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhonto mālā-gandhavilepanaṃ dhārento jātarūpa-rajataṃ sādiyanto maṇikanaka-vicitta-molibaddho sammā paṭipanno ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ, pabbajito pi bhaṇḍu kāsāvavatthavasano parapiṇḍam-ajjhupagato catusu sīlakkhandhesu sammā paripūrakārī diyaḍḍhesu sikkhāpadasatesu samādāya vattanto terasasu dhutaguṇesu anavasesaṃ vattanto sammā paṭipanno ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ;
mil6.1.3:1.4: tattha bhante ko viseso gihino vā pabbajitassa vā,
mil6.1.3:1.6: vañjhā sikkhāpadagopanā, moghaṃ dhutaguṇasamādānaṃ, kiṃ tattha dukkham-anuciṇṇena, nanu nāma sukhen' eva sukhaṃ adhigantabban-ti.
mil6.1.3:2.2: Gihino vā 'haṃ bhikkhave pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi, gihī vā bhikkhave pabbajito vā sammā paṭipanno sammāpaṭipattādhikaraṇaṃ ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalan-ti.
mil6.1.3:2.3: Evam-etaṃ mahārāja, sammā paṭipanno va seṭṭho. Pabbajito pi mahārāja: pabbajito 'mhīti na sammā paṭipajjeyya, atha kho so ārakā va sāmaññā, ārakā va brahmaññā; pag-eva gihī odātavasano.
mil6.1.3:2.4: Gihī pi mahārāja sammā paṭipanno ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ, pabbajito pi mahārāja sammā paṭipanno ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mil6.1.3:3.1: Api ca mahārāja pabbajito va sāmaññassa issaro adhipati,
mil6.1.3:3.2: pabbajjā mahārāja bahuguṇā anekaguṇā appamāṇaguṇā, na sakkā pabbajjāya guṇā parimāṇaṃ kātuṃ.
mil6.1.3:4.1: Yathā mahārāja kāmadadassa maṇiratanassa na sakkā dhanena aggho parimāṇaṃ kātuṃ: ettakaṃ maṇiratanassa mūlanti;
mil6.1.3:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja pabbajjā bahuguṇā anekaguṇā appamāṇaguṇā, na sakkā pabbajjāya guṇā parimāṇaṃ kātuṃ.
mil6.1.3:5.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja mahāsamudde ūmiyo na sakkā parimāṇaṃ kātuṃ: ettakā mahāsamudde ūmiyo ti;
mil6.1.3:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja pabbajjā bahuguṇā anekaguṇā appamāṇaguṇā, na sakkā pabbajjāya guṇā parimāṇaṃ kātuṃ.
mil6.1.3:6.1: Pabbajitassa mahārāja yaṃ kiñci karaṇīyaṃ sabban-taṃ khippam-eva samijjhati no cira rattāya;
mil6.1.3:6.3: pabbajito mahārāja appiccho hoti santuṭṭho pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho āraddhaviriyo nirālayo aniketo paripuṇṇasīlo sallekhitācāro dhutapaṭipattikusalo hoti; tankāraṇā pabbajitassa yaṃ kiñci karaṇīyaṃ sabban-taṃ khippam-eva samijjhati no cirarattāya.
mil6.1.3:6.4: Yathā mahārāja niggaṇṭhi-sama-sudhota-uju-vimala-nārāco susajjito sammā vahati,
mil6.1.3:6.5: evam-eva kho mahārāja pabbajitassa yaṃ kiñci karaṇīyaṃ sabban-taṃ khippam-eva samijjhati no cirarattāyāti. -
mil6.1.3:6.6: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
